entries.title: Specifying Systems, Leslie Lamport
entries.location: Selected returned text: PDF pages 123-124 (printed 106-107), 139-141 (printed 122-124), 147-148 (printed 130-131); no full-book reading
entries.root_review_note: Weak/strong fairness distinguish continuous versus repeated enabling. Real-time upper-bound conditions and unbounded time progress are separate requirements; merely adding fairness does not supply a deadline. Root checked these definitions, not every external citation or the product mapping.

entries.title: MCP Tasks Extension specification 2026-07-28
entries.location: Task Status; Task Creation; Task Cancellation; Protocol Errors; Task Execution Errors, returned lines 149-155, 269-270, 350-359, 705-754
entries.root_review_note: The task status completed includes a CallToolResult with isError true; failed is reserved for JSON-RPC execution errors. Cancel success acknowledges the request but need not stop work or eventually become cancelled. Expired task disappearance is allowed. These are protocol claims, not observed server behavior.

entries.title: A2A Protocol v1.0.1 specification
entries.location: Selected returned text, sections 3.1.3-3.1.6 and 3.2.2; version 1.0.0 was viewed first as discovery and is not used as the frozen release
entries.root_review_note: CancelTask attempts cancellation and returns updated state without guaranteeing cancellation success. SubscribeToTask starts with current Task and ends at a terminal state; it is not a guaranteed historical-event replay. The normal response behavior is further qualified by returnImmediately configuration. Root does not infer business acceptance or durable external effects from these states.
